newsitem.title: USA: Indictment sought for two former ADM execs - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Indictment sought for two former ADM execs - WSJ.

text.p: Prosecuters are expected to ask a federal grand jury in Chicago to indict two recently departed Archer Daniels Midland Co executives on criminal antitrust charges, The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday.

The newspaper cites people familiar with the case, saying the Justice Department will seek charges against Michael Andreas, former executive vice president, and Terrance Wilson, former head of corn processing for the decatur, Ill., company.
Andreas took a leave of absense and Wilson retired two days after the company pleaded guilty in October to two criminal price-fixing charges involving citric acid and lysine, the newspaper said.
The company paid a record $100 million in fines.
